$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$p=$null;try{$p=[Diagnostics.Process]::GetProcessById(${pid});$null=$p.SafeHandle;$c=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'ProcessId=${pid}';@{pid=$p.Id;parentPid=[int]$c.ParentProcessId;createdAtTicks=$p.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks.ToString();executablePath=$p.MainModule.FileName;sessionId=$p.SessionId}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress}catch [ArgumentException]{'null'}finally{if($p){$p.Dispose()}}
